note: Team notes for the pilot day, from the Zocus WhatsApp group, plus what Claude read from the recordings at each refresh. One entry per conversation, keyed by the conversation number. Fields: rep (nickname), customer, segment, model / models (as the customer saw them), fuel, colour, quote (yes, no or promised: whether a quotation was given), priorities (what the customer cares about, when the automatic reading is wrong), value (rupees, set by hand), remarks (shown on the conversation), prices (what was quoted: m = model or variant, p = rupees or text, b = basis, at = time in the recording), tr_en (English for key transcript lines, keyed by the line's time), csv (any CSV column to override, for example objection_quote_en), stage (exploring, finalising or after_booking), payment, visit (first or repeat), history (what happened before this visit and where we know it from), arrived (counter punch-in time, HH:MM), need_form (answers from Mahindra's need-analyzer form), stock (want, have, inhand = yes, no or unknown, alt = what else was offered, at), objections (t, at, q = customer's line in English, a = the rep's answer, v = answered, partly or open, tip = suggested better line), followups (written by hand: t, at, due, q, d = message, s = 1 when it is our suggestion and not a promise), crm (variant, payment, delivery_wanted, exchange, registration), kind (delivery = a conversation after the sale, not a sales pitch), result_label, drop (true to leave the call out) with why. backend_only: true (14 Nov, 5 pm) means the dashboard shows only what the backend analysis says about objections, follow-ups and stock; the hand-written stock, objections and followups below are kept for later but not used. test_drive_note (text shown next to the test drive in the panel).

266.remarks: An early enquiry about electric cars. The customer drives about 50 km a day and was shown the XUV 3XO EV (AX5 and AX7L, 39 kWh); the rep also described the BE 6, XEV 9e and XEV 9S. 272.remarks: A short visit to settle the final price and delivery of a red XUV 3XO. The customer is choosing between the RevX A and the AX5 and also asked for a RevX C quotation. Asked about original accessories (spoiler, connected tail lamp), alloy wheels, BH-series registration, insurance and the extended warranty. The rep sent the RevX A and AX5 quotations and the BH document list on WhatsApp during the conversation, so the on-road figures were not said aloud. The rep asked a colleague for the alloy price. No booking was made; the customer said they would come back.

The electric car was not at the showroom, so the AX5 EV and AX7L were described but not shown; a CNG test drive was offered (8:00) and the rep offered to introduce another EV sales consultant (8:37). The 9S was pointed out on the floor (8:37). The customer said diesel is not wanted and compared with the Tata Altroz CNG. The stage is our reading (a customer still choosing between EV and CNG), not the team's.
